objective: Create the smallest active Plan -> Write -> Truth -> Product learning path that Phase 3 can instrument without refactoring the whole production system.

decisions.decision: Use a vertical-slice MVP instead of completing the original broad Phase 2 cleanup plan.
decisions.reason: The owner explicitly prioritized running all three phases over perfecting any one phase.

decisions.decision: Add learning_runtime/ as a separate architecture-learning path and leave the existing production router/rework/replay machinery intact.
decisions.reason: Phase 2 needs one unambiguous learning path, not a risky rewrite of production compatibility code.

decisions.decision: Keep exactly four stages: plan, write, truth, product.
decisions.reason: This is the minimum topology needed for the first Phase 3 fault split: construction vs evaluation, then plan vs realization.

decisions.decision: Use deterministic fixture replay rather than live agents.
decisions.reason: Phase 2 validates execution/artifact boundaries only. New creative generation and white-box instrumentation are Phase 3 concerns.

decisions.decision: Mark historical Truth as LEGACY_UNTRUSTED and guided owner review as diagnostic-only when replayed.
decisions.reason: A smoke fixture must not silently promote known-bad historical evaluator outputs into ground truth.

decisions.decision: Do not add trace.jsonl, agent registry, event bus, root-cause engine or module framework.
decisions.reason: Those additions would prematurely turn Phase 2 into Phase 3/platform work.

validation.scope_note: The failing production tests exercise historical-substrate/current-Sumer production state and files not modified by Phase 2. They are recorded as baseline debt and intentionally not repaired inside this MVP architecture change.

known_limitations: The runtime currently proves topology with immutable fixtures rather than live agent execution.
No Phase 3 trace or root-cause diagnosis exists yet.
The Phase 1 benchmark is intentionally MVP-level and remains a measurement dependency rather than a completed evaluation product.
The repository has unrelated failing production baseline tests that were not expanded into Phase 2 scope.
